findings.evidence: `exists_quiverRepHomOfModule_eq` at lines 402–406 already constructs the same map and proves fullness from `[Finite Q]` by installing `Fintype.ofFinite Q`, demonstrating that the stronger public assumptions are implementation-only.
findings.fix: Define the recovered map under `[Finite Q]` using a local `let := Fintype.ofFinite Q`; retain `[Fintype Q]` only on `moduleHomOfQuiverRepHom_apply`, whose statement explicitly contains `∑ v : Q`, and remove it from the component/fullness lemmas.
findings.issue: `moduleHomOfQuiverRepHom`, `moduleHomOfQuiverRepHom_apply_of_mem` (line 383), and `quiverRepHomOfModule_moduleHomOfQuiverRepHom` (line 391) require `[Fintype Q]`, although their types contain no finite sum and the surrounding section already has `[Finite Q]`.

summary: The recovered-map API unnecessarily exposes `Fintype Q` even where no enumeration occurs in the declaration’s type.
